verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for an HR/payroll SaaS platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documented retention policies, deletion endpoints or tools, or data-lifecycle settings for production data. The only deletion evidence is the API sandbox reset, which wipes test data. That is an adjacent developer-testing feature, not user control over real data retention.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
